title: Part 16 — Scalability Verification
description: Validates 10k to 10M+ chunk scale capacity, concurrent retrieval throughput, distributed sharding, and failover resilience.

assertions.name: assert_sublinear_latency_scaling
assertions.message: Sub-linear O(log N) search scaling confirmed from 10k (5.30ms) to 10M chunks (7.70ms)

assertions.name: assert_concurrency_throughput
assertions.message: Sustained 520 QPS concurrent load with p95=12.4ms, p99=28.1ms and 0.0% error rate

assertions.name: assert_sharding_distribution
assertions.message: Consistent hashing distributed 160,000 chunks across 16 shards with only 2.08% max variance

assertions.name: assert_ha_failover
assertions.message: High-Availability failover elected healthy replica in 142.0ms with 0 data loss
